title: Persist SafetyGateDecision records with fail-closed observations and traces

gates.name: safety decision persistence and trace tests

verify: SafetyGateDecision persistence captures decision, reason_code, freshness_status, required_next_action, approval_required, source/evidence refs, trace refs, expiry, and redaction status.
Unavailable, malformed, over-budget, invalid proposal, or uncertain classification returns structured fail-closed observation.
Every proposal receives exactly one structured observation and trace event.
evidence_required: structured observation tests for success, denied, blocked, missing data, malformed, timeout, and budget stop
trace/eval recorder evidence without hidden reasoning or secrets
constraints: Errors, denials, timeouts, and budget stops become structured observations.
Traces record operational events only and do not expose hidden reasoning or secrets.
invariants: Every tool/action proposal receives exactly one structured observation.
Runtime permission and Safety Gate decisions happen outside the model.
Safety Gate fails closed when unavailable, malformed, over-budget, or uncertain.
verification_targets: no hidden reasoning or secret leakage
